text.title: Architect Skill Index (Geek Tier) — Output Contract
text.summary: The index is one JSON document with one section per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: clusters named by architecture activity, each entry with the five fixed fields (slug, architect_why, load_when, est_tokens, target_status), an entry count of at least 50 or an explicit shortfall, an uncovered-tasks section, and the relink run that re-resolved every slug. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the index's title as published in the geek tier
geek — the tier that promises 50+ entries (r-minimum-fifty-distinct-targets)
named by architecture activity, never by tool; at least three entries each (r-clustered-by-architecture-activity)

exactly slug, architect_why, load_when, est_tokens, target_status; the slug resolves to an active methodology and appears once in the whole index (r-entry-resolves-to-existing-slug, r-entry-fields-fixed)
distinct target slugs across all clusters; under 50 requires a shortfall block, never padding (r-minimum-fifty-distinct-targets)
architecture tasks with no active methodology, each with the closest partial match or none (r-uncovered-tasks-listed)
the script, its last run URL and the next due date that re-resolve every slug and re-read every est_tokens (r-relinked-at-review-cadence)
URLs: the relink run, the PR that published the index

forbidden.pattern: an entry whose slug does not resolve under skills/faion/knowledge or whose target_status is not active (fm-dangling-wikilinks)
architect_why equal to or paraphrasing the target's own meta.json summary, or containing "useful for architects" (fm-copied-developer-summary)
a cluster named spec-kit, plan-mode, RAG, graph-reviewer or any other tool or feature name (fm-tool-named-clusters)
the same slug under two clusters, or entry_count at or above 50 reached with entries whose architect_why names no architecture task (fm-padding-to-fifty)
an entry missing load_when or est_tokens, or est_tokens differing from the target's meta.json (fm-no-load-signal)
uncovered_tasks empty, or an index with no relink run linked in evidence[] (fm-implied-completeness, r-relinked-at-review-cadence)

allowed-transformations.transformation: Merge a cluster with fewer than three entries into the nearest activity rather than inventing entries to fill it.
Where a target is renamed between reviews, re-point the entry in the same relink run and keep its architect_why if the task it serves is unchanged.
Record a shortfall honestly: entry_count below 50 with the missing count and the uncovered tasks that explain it.

list.item: Every entry slug resolves to a directory under skills/faion/knowledge whose meta.json status is active, and no slug appears under two clusters.
Every architect_why names an architecture task (boundary decision, ADR, fitness function, quality-attribute trade-off, cross-cutting review) and is not the target's summary.
Every cluster is named by activity and has at least three entries; no cluster is named after a tool.
entry_count is the number of distinct slugs; below 50 the shortfall block states how many are missing and why.
Every entry carries load_when and est_tokens equal to the target's meta.json.
uncovered_tasks has at least one line; relink.run_url is in evidence[] and next_due is within one review cadence.
